newsitem.title: USA: Fishermen found after 5 days adrift in Caribbean.
newsitem.headline: Fishermen found after 5 days adrift in Caribbean.

text.p: Three Colombians and an American adrift on a disabled fishing boat for five days were rescued last Friday after a search of the Caribbean covering more than 13,000 square miles (33,670 sq km), the U.S. Coast Guard said on Monday.
The men left San Andres Island, a Colombian territory off the coast of Nicaragua, on Oct. 13 for a daylong fishing tournament but failed to return the next day, officials said.
The United States Navy and Coast Guard joined searchers from Nicaragua and Colombia and found the drifting boat about 100 miles (160 km) south of San Andres.
A Coast Guard search crew dropped a life raft and radio to the fishermen who were picked up on Friday by a merchant vessel in the area and taken to San Andres for medical treatment, officials said.
The Coast Guard identified the American as Jack Cybal. His hometown was not known.
